message.content: This vertical editorial illustration features a red background with a central illustration of two pairs of hands holding a grey fabric sheet. The sheet sags in the center, supporting the lower body and head of an individual. One bare foot and one foot wearing a blue-soled sandal point upward, while a person’s face is partially visible behind the feet. The hands on the left emerge from a sleeve with a green and brown camouflage pattern, while the hands on the right emerge from a solid brown sleeve. At the top, the large white word "TEMPO" is centered. Above it, smaller text reads "KE MANA DANA PENGAMPUNAN PAJAK". Below "TEMPO," a tagline says "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". To the left of the title is a green and yellow "45" logo. Large black text in the center reads "AKHIR PELARIAN SANTOSO," followed by smaller text: "DRAMA PENYERBUAN SANG BURON. POLISI ATAU TENTARA LEBIH BERPERAN?". In the bottom left corner, there is a price of "RP 39.500," the date "25-31 JULI 2016," and a barcode.
